verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same. In both, the full-width yellow hashtag band has shrunk to a small boxed tag, and the list and CTA text is tiny for a 160px-wide skyscraper. A breaks the list badly: "Shortness of breath Dry / cough" and "Sore throat Headache" run separate symptoms together, so the six-item list can't be read. B splits most items onto their own lines, but it still merges "Sore throat Headache" into one line. In both, the doctor illustration floats in the lower middle with dead space around it, and the yellow CTA is tiny and pushed to the bottom edge.
